text:
Sara: Heads-up: after rolling cilium 1.19 to west2-gpu yesterday we see intermittent pod->pod packet drops and 15-40ms spikes on east-west for large-batch training jobs. Started ~03:00 UTC.

InfraBot: deploy: cilium/1.19 rolled to k8s-west2-gpu by deployer@infra at 2025-11-02T03:00:12Z

Mike: do we have packet captures / dmesg? any MTU change? are pods using hostNetwork or mtu bump?

Raj: I grabbed pings and iperf from two gpu pods on same node and across nodes. same-node fine, cross-node shows 0.5-2% loss and 1500->1500 fragmentation warnings. sample: 'ping -s 1200' fails intermittently. tcpdump shows GENEVE hdr present, outer mtu 1450. node ip link show: 'vxlan0 mtu 1450'.

Toni: That sounds like tunnel MTU got reduced by cilium defaulting to 1450 when GSO offload handling changed in 1.19. RDMA/GPUDirect workloads need jumbo frames. Can you paste 'cilium status' and CNI config?

Raj: pasted config snippet: 'encapsulation: geneve, tunnelMTU: 1450, enableGSO: false, bpfPolicy: enabled'

Lee: short-term mitigation: set tunnel-mtu to 8900 on cilium-config and restart daemonset on a small canary pool. Or set 'noEncap' for intra-node to avoid tunnel overhead. Rolling rollback is also option.

Sara: Can we canary the mtu change? we have 3 nodes in west2-gpu-canal pool. I'll patch cilium config for one node. @Mike can you watch cluster telemetry for retransmits / bpf drops?

Mike: watching now :eyes: If we see drop to <0.5% after canary, we patch rest. If not, we'll rollback to 1.18 and open vendor ticket.

Raj: FYI logs from kernel: 'GENEVE: rx_fragmented packet len 1600, outer_mtu 1450' and 'nf_conntrack: table full, dropping' — conntrack table grew ~12k entries over 30m during training bursts. Attached small tcpdump lines: 'IP hostA > hostB: UDP, length 1540'

Toni: Also check offload flags with 'ethtool -k' on host NICs, cilium 1.19 changed how GSO/TSO are handled; some NIC drivers require toggling GRO/TSO.

InfraBot: incident created: INC-2025-987 west2-cilium-mtu-high-pct assigned: @Sara @Mike severity: low-urgent.

Lee: I'll put a rollback plan on runbook: 'kubectl -n kube-system set image ds/cilium cilium/cilium:1.18.8 && monitor 30m'

Sara: Patch applied to west2-gpu-node-3 canary. initial metrics: inter-pod loss down from 1.8% -> 0.2%, p50 latency from 35ms -> 6ms. proceeding to rest of pool with caution. :thumbsup:

Mike: good numbers, keep an eye on conntrack and kernel drops. If we still see RDMA flakiness after mtu restore we escalate to cilium maintainers.

Raj: saved the tcpdump and dmesg snippet in /mnt/logs/west2/cilium-mtu-canary-1861234567.pcap and /var/log/messages.

Toni: follow-ups: add a unit test for tunnel MTU detection in our upgrade playbook and call out RDMA workloads in release notes.

Sara: noted. closing the loop here once full pool patched. thanks team. :rocket:
